title: Completeness of the width-three-CNF encoding
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits and $g$ gates, and let $x$ be an input accepted by $C$. Then the width-three CNF encoding of $C$ is satisfied by the sign assignment on the $n+g$ coordinates obtained from $x$ and the values of all gates of $C$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit with input dimension n
An input assignment to the circuit
